name: Account reset password
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Account reset password.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Legacy customer account template. Shopify owns account authentication, email delivery and session rules. Current customer accounts operate outside the theme; this section does not migrate accounts or add social login.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.default: Enter a new password for your account.
settings.how: Enter the subheading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.default: Choose a secure password you have not used before.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Show password toggles
settings.how: Turn on “Show password toggles” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Help text
settings.default: Use a strong password with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. Avoid using the same password across multiple websites.
